Measure absolute PL quantum yields. Same FLS920P with integrating sphere. Vessel geometry, spatial arrangement and particle shape are unassigned. Source-derived conceptual operation; no measured apparatus geometry.

Image the films by fluorescence microscopy. Leica DMI6000B halogen lamp; blue DAPI, green GFP, red Cy3/RFP band-pass filters. Lamp settings are not film-processing conditions. general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
